title: CanonicalVersionCreatedPayload
description: Payload of the CanonicalVersionCreated event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2854 (T10). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

precedingDocUuid.description: Set by canonical-svc only on a credit note whose precedingDocumentNumber is populated and which resolved to exactly one document of the same entity, direction and issuer, with that number and, when precedingDocumentDate is populated, that transaction date. Absent when none or several match, and on a credit note with blank preceding fields. Read by submission-svc for the credit-note hold (INV-REQ-709, INV-Q-6311). Optional so an older consumer validates.

nettedCreditNoteDocUuids.description: Set by canonical-svc on the version of a revised invoice for the keys of nettedCreditNoteKeys that already name a recorded credit note of the same entity. Written only when the version is created (a version is never edited), so it may be absent. Read by submission-svc for the decision of INV-Q-6623 and INV-Q-6614 (INV-REQ-558). Optional so an older consumer validates.

nettedByDocUuid.description: Set by canonical-svc on the version of a credit note when a recorded revised invoice whose current version lists the credit note's sourceKey exists. Written only when the version is created (a version is never edited), so it may be absent. Read by submission-svc for the decision of INV-Q-6623 and INV-Q-6614 (INV-REQ-558). Optional so an older consumer validates.

docsequence.description: The per-document monotonic sequence (INV-REQ-1221), duplicated in the payload alongside the envelope's own docsequence extension attribute.

scopeVerdict.description: The document/line scope verdict this version carries (services.yaml 'document scope verdict').

notSubmittableReason.description: Why this version is not submittable. Set by canonical-svc only when scopeVerdict is NOT_SUBMITTABLE for one of these causes; same members and meaning as the notSubmittableReason property of the canonical API. Optional so that an older consumer validates. A consumer that finds NOT_SUBMITTABLE without it classifies the variance as unexplained.

appliedPackVersions.description: The rule pack versions applied to derive this canonical version.

traceReference.description: Opaque reference to the underlying decision/evidence trace, resolvable by evidence-svc.

routingFacts.description: The facts submission-svc needs at derivation step 9 (INV-REQ-415, INV-REQ-408, INV-REQ-373, INV-REQ-319; INV-Q-6988 option A). Set by canonical-svc, read by submission-svc only. It is not a submission type (INV-REQ-479): the routing rule lives in submission-svc. Optional so an older producer validates.

direction.description: The direction of the document as recorded.

networkPath.description: ISSUED_VIA_NETWORK when the record request carried networkIssuance, RECEIVED_VIA_NETWORK when it carried networkReceipt, RELAY_ISSUANCE when the document was recorded through requestIssuance, NOT_ON_NETWORK otherwise.

counterpartyOnNetwork.description: The onNetwork of the masterdata Reachability. Absent when no lookup was made, which routes the document off the network (INV-REQ-319).

debitNote.description: True when the document function is DEBIT_NOTE. Absent means false.

selfBillingAssignment.description: The party-to-type assignment of a self-billed document, copied by canonical-svc from the rules result without reading its fields (INV-REQ-415).

canonicalDocument.description: The canonical version itself (INV-NOTE-3 §20.2 to §20.5; content added 25 Sep 2026, AD-30). payload-svc builds its projection from this, reconciliation-svc its Box read model (FR-Z.16), evidence-svc its retained copy (FR-AA.15) and console-bff its search index (SCR-03.1); submission-svc reads docUuid/version/docsequence only, not this object. Kept for the content window only (FR-AH.9). Every content field below carries its FR-AE.72 classification, as a {value, classification} pair.

documentTypeCode.description: The document type code. Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification (INV-NOTE-3 §20; content added 25 Sep 2026, AD-30).

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

currency.description: The document currency. Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification (INV-NOTE-3 §20; content added 25 Sep 2026, AD-30).

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

parties.description: The document's parties. Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification (INV-NOTE-3 §20; content added 25 Sep 2026, AD-30).

identifierScheme.description: The identifier scheme of the party's identifier (INV-Q-7104).

identifierValue.description: The party's identifier; where identifierScheme is SG_UEN it is the UEN of INV-TERM-307 partyUen (INV-Q-7104).

identifierScheme.description: The identifier scheme of the party's identifier (INV-Q-7104).

identifierValue.description: The party's identifier; where identifierScheme is SG_UEN it is the UEN of INV-TERM-307 partyUen (INV-Q-7104).

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

lines.description: The document's lines. Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification (INV-NOTE-3 §20; content added 25 Sep 2026, AD-30).

unitPrice.description: Unit price. Money as a decimal string (API-12).

lineAmount.description: Line amount. Money as a decimal string (API-12).

unitCode.description: The unit of measure code of the line (INV-Q-7104).

taxAmount.description: Line tax amount. Money as a decimal string (API-12).

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

taxSubtotals.description: The document's tax subtotals. Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification (INV-NOTE-3 §20; content added 25 Sep 2026, AD-30).

taxableAmount.description: Taxable amount for this tax code. Money as a decimal string (API-12).

taxAmount.description: Tax amount for this tax code. Money as a decimal string (API-12).

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

totals.description: The document's totals. Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification (INV-NOTE-3 §20; content added 25 Sep 2026, AD-30).

totalExcludingTax.description: Total excluding tax. Money as a decimal string (API-12).

totalTax.description: Total tax. Money as a decimal string (API-12).

totalIncludingTax.description: Total including tax. Money as a decimal string (API-12).

sgdTotalExcludingTax.description: Total excluding tax in SGD. Stated by the caller in SGD; the System validates it and never recomputes it (FR-M.7). Required together with the other SGD totals and exchangeRate when the transaction currency is not SGD (INV-REQ-466, INV-NOTE-3 section 19.5). Money as a decimal string (API-12).

sgdTotalTax.description: Total tax (GST) in SGD. Stated by the caller in SGD; the System validates it and never recomputes it (FR-M.7). Required together with the other SGD totals and exchangeRate when the transaction currency is not SGD (INV-REQ-466, INV-NOTE-3 section 19.5). Money as a decimal string (API-12).

sgdTotalIncludingTax.description: Total including tax in SGD. Stated by the caller in SGD; the System validates it and never recomputes it (FR-M.7). Required together with the other SGD totals and exchangeRate when the transaction currency is not SGD (INV-REQ-466, INV-NOTE-3 section 19.5). Money as a decimal string (API-12).

value.description: The SGD totals (sgdTotalExcludingTax, sgdTotalTax, sgdTotalIncludingTax) are present when currency.value is not SGD (INV-REQ-466), checked by payload-svc as PAY-005; optional here (API-41).

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

precedingDocumentNumber.description: Preceding Invoice Number (IBT-025) of the invoice a credit note corrects, where known (INV-REQ-560); payload-svc builds IBT-025 from it (INV-AC-1777). Optional. Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification (INV-NOTE-3 §20.2, INV-TERM-302; added by INV-T-3457, INV-Q-3450).

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

nettedCreditNoteKeys.description: The sourceKey values of the credit notes that this revised invoice nets, as declared by the ERP (INV-Q-6614, INV-REQ-558). Optional. Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification (INV-NOTE-3 §20.2).

value.description: The sourceKey values of the netted credit notes.

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

gstNotAdjusted.description: The caller's declaration that supplier and customer agreed not to adjust the GST charged on the original invoice and the conditions for doing so are met. Allowed only when documentFunction is CREDIT_NOTE; any other combination is a contract violation, refused with 400 and SRT-001. Absent means false. The System does not verify the conditions and never infers the marker (INV-REQ-693, INV-Q-6639). Optional. Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification tag.

value.description: True when the credit note is declared as issued without GST adjustment.

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

precedingDocumentDate.description: Preceding Invoice Date (IBT-026) of the invoice a credit note corrects, where known (INV-REQ-560); payload-svc builds IBT-026 from it (INV-AC-1777). Optional. Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification (INV-NOTE-3 §20.2, INV-TERM-302; added by INV-T-3457, INV-Q-3450).

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

precedingBlankJustification.description: Justification recorded for a credit note with blank preceding-invoice fields (INV-REQ-561). Optional. Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification (INV-NOTE-3 §20.2, INV-TERM-302; added by INV-T-3457, INV-Q-3450).

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

evidenceRef.description: Reference to the documentary evidence that GST was accounted for on the original supplies, for a blank-linked credit note (INV-REQ-561). Optional. Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification (INV-NOTE-3 §20.2, INV-TERM-302; added by INV-T-3457, INV-Q-3450).

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

taxCurrencyCode.description: The tax currency code, always SGD; present on every version (INV-REQ-466). Set by canonical-svc.

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

exchangeRate.description: The exchange rate applied; present when currency.value is not SGD (INV-REQ-467), checked by payload-svc as PAY-005.

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

exchangeRateSource.description: The source of the exchange rate, recorded for audit; present when currency.value is not SGD (INV-REQ-467), checked by payload-svc as PAY-005.

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

documentNumber.description: The document number issued to the customer (IBT-001), where known (INV-REQ-714, INV-AC-766); payload-svc builds IBT-001 from it and the internal accounting reference is never used. Optional: its absence is stopped downstream by PAY-001, not by this schema. Never the sourceKey. Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification (INV-Q-6268).

value.description: The document number issued to the customer.

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

documentDate.description: The document date, the caller's transactionDate as the source records it (INV-Q-6515); canonical-svc sets it from the request. The top-level transactionDate of this payload stays the date of record canonical-svc derives. Optional (INV-Q-7104). Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification.

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

invoiceNote.description: The invoice note (INV-TERM-302); canonical-svc takes it from the ingestion notes. Optional (INV-Q-7104). Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification.

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

identityTriple.description: The supplier identity triple (Sender ID, Supplier ID, Supplier GSTN) that masterdata-svc resolved for the entity and its legal constitution at derivation step 8 (INV-REQ-310, INV-REQ-479, INV-BR-1452), as canonical-svc stored it with this version; payload-svc writes the Sender ID, IBT-030 and IBT-031 of the document from it and from nothing else (INV-REQ-699, INV-REQ-803). Set by canonical-svc from the masterdata resolution, never from the caller's parties, so a document submitted by an overseas shared service centre or an agent still names the entity. A version is never edited, so a later change of the triple does not alter a recorded version. Absent on a version recorded before this pair existed. Optional (API-41). Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification (INV-Q-7142).

value.description: The three values exactly as masterdata-svc returned them in its IdentityTripleFacts (masterdata/openapi.yaml); canonical-svc does not reformat them.

senderId.description: Sender ID, the Peppol ID of the SBDH envelope.

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

buyerInvoiceRefs.description: The references of the self-billing invoices the customer issued that this document derives from (INV-REQ-696, INV-Q-7045). Required for a SALE document of an entity that the Scope pack's self-billing assignment (INV-REQ-416) puts on the Type 2 side, a condition canonical-svc enforces by refusing the record request with 400 and SRT-001, not this schema; otherwise optional. Wrapped with its FR-AE.72 classification (INV-Q-6268).

value.description: The references of the self-billing invoices the customer issued.

classification.description: The FR-AE.72 data classification tag for this content field.

DataClass.description: The personal-data class of a content field (INV-REQ-883, INV-AC-1915, FR-AE.72): NONE, IDENTIFYING or SENSITIVE. Each canonicalDocument wrapper pins its own class as a one-member enum of these values; the registry canonical/data-classification.tsv holds the same class per unit (check-data-classification).
